name: dispatch_song_command
description: Entry point of the music driver that switches on a command number: it sets up the timer and interrupt vector, starts or fades playback, plays and stops sound effects, and pauses or resumes the song. Unknown command numbers simply return.

name: dispatch_song_command_alias
description: Second entry to the same command dispatcher, reached by the segment loader and by a branch from the first entry. Its body matches the main dispatcher, so it handles the same command numbers.

name: start_sfx_channel
description: Starts a queued sound effect on the channel recorded in the sound state. It sets the channel's DMA and interrupt enable bits, loads the sample pointer, length and volume, and programs the period from a fixed clock constant divided by the stored pitch.

name: load_track_table_entry
description: Looks up a 32-bit entry in a table using the index stored in the track record, saves it into the record, and zeroes a 16-bit field. It is a small per-track setup step.

name: start_song_playback
description: Stores the song pointer passed in the address register and marks the player as ready to start. It does nothing when the pointer is zero or negative.

name: get_song_state
description: Returns the current playback state word of the song player without changing anything.

name: service_music_interrupt
description: Runs once per frame from the interrupt vector: it updates the sound effect handling, starts the song when it is queued, counts down fades, and steps all four voice tracks by writing their audio channel registers. When no track remains active it returns the player to the stopped state.

name: stop_song_playback
description: Sets the player state to stopped and then runs the interrupt tick once to finish the stop. Callers use it to end playback cleanly.

name: step_song_fade
description: Advances the volume fade by one step: it counts the fade down and writes a per-channel level to each of the four audio channels. When the count runs out it silences the four channels and returns the player to stopped.

name: decrement_wait_counter
description: Counts down a 16-bit delay counter in the record while it is non-zero, and leaves it alone once it reaches zero.

name: init_song_tracks
description: Loads the four track start pointers from the song table into the track records and marks playback as active. It then programs each of the four audio channels, and ends playback if no track is active.

name: disable_audio_channels
description: Turns off the four audio DMA channels and their interrupts by writing clear masks to the DMA and interrupt control registers. It is used when a song stops or pauses.

name: advance_track_sequence
description: Reads the next command from a track's byte stream, handling jump, loop, end, voice-select, volume and setting codes. When a note is due it looks up the voice's sample data and programs the channel's pointer, length, period and volume.

name: slide_track_value
description: Steps a slide effect: when its countdown expires it reloads the countdown and moves a stored value by a signed increment. It then writes the result through a stored pointer.

name: bounce_slide_value
description: Adds the slide step to the current value, reversing the direction when the value reaches its limit. The result is written through a stored pointer.

name: mute_track_channel
description: Silences a track's audio channel when its mode flag allows it. It clears the channel's DMA bit, zeroes its volume and resets the track's gate value.

name: advance_track_sequence_variant
description: A second copy of the track sequencer step, called from the channel loop of the interrupt tick. Its command handling matches the other copy, so the same command codes are decoded.

name: start_track_note
description: Starts a new note on a track: it reads the note length from a lookup table and, when a voice is set, computes the sample length and writes the volume and period to the audio channel.

name: read_track_commands_to_note
description: Consumes track command bytes until a note byte appears, applying jump, loop, end, voice-select, volume and setting codes. It then starts that note with its length and volume.

name: fetch_next_track_note
description: Loads the next position from the track stream and repeats the command handling until a note is reached. It then starts that note with its length and volume, sharing its command handling with the neighbouring track routines.

name: restart_track_sequence
description: Rewinds a track to the start of its byte stream and reads commands from there until a note is reached, then starts that note. It is entered whenever a track has to begin again from its first position.

name: reset_track_word
description: Clears the first 16-bit field of a track record to zero. It is a one-instruction reset used by the track setup code.

name: select_voice_and_note
description: Selects a voice from the voice table, then reads track commands until a note is reached and starts it. Its command handling matches the neighbouring track routines.

name: load_cia_timer_high_byte
description: Writes a byte from the track stream and a start value to the CIA timer high register and its control register. It then reads track commands until a note is reached and starts that note.

name: load_cia_timer_low_byte
description: Writes a byte from the track stream and a start value to the CIA timer low register. It then reads track commands until a note is reached and starts that note.

name: set_track_volume_and_read
description: Stores the volume value from the track stream in the track record and the channel volume field. It then continues reading track commands until a note is reached and starts it.

name: set_track_setting_and_read
description: Stores a setting value from the track stream in the track record. It then continues reading track commands until a note is reached and starts it.

name: start_track_note_alt_layout
description: Starts a new note using the alternate track record layout: it counts down the note timer, computes the sample length, and writes the volume and period through the stored pointers. It is the second variant of the note start routine.

name: write_scaled_track_volume
description: Scales a volume value by the sound effect music volume and writes the result through a stored pointer. It then re-enables the channel's DMA bit and marks the track as active.

name: compute_note_period
description: Computes the audio period for the current note by dividing a frequency table entry by a scaled sample rate. It stores the period in the channel and track records and copies two fields from the linked record.

name: handle_audio_channel_interrupts
description: Audio interrupt handler that calls the per-channel check four times, once for each of the four Paula audio channels.

name: check_channel_interrupt
description: Handles the end of a sample on one channel when its interrupt is pending. It either chains the next queued buffer or, for a sound effect, clears the effect's state and silences the channel.

name: end_sfx_on_channel
description: Ends a sound effect on its channel: it clears the channel's sound effect flag, points the channel at silence, turns off its DMA bit, and resets the track's gate and counters.

name: load_pending_channel_sample
description: Copies the pending sample address and period into the channel's pointer and period fields and resets the gate value so the channel plays it. It runs when the next buffer on a channel is due.

name: count_down_sfx_timer
description: Counts down a sound effect's remaining duration on its channel. When the count reaches zero it ends the effect by silencing the channel and clearing its sound flag.

name: find_voice_header_chunk
description: Scans forward two bytes at a time until it reaches the four-character voice header tag, then leaves the pointer on it. It returns the pointer for the caller to read the header.

name: find_body_chunk_tag
description: Scans forward two bytes at a time until it finds the four-character BODY tag that introduces the sample data. It returns with the pointer on that tag.

name: patch_segment_jump_stubs
description: Checks whether a loaded code segment has already been patched and, if it has not, fills its jump stubs with absolute-jump instructions aimed at the resolved routine addresses. A segment patched earlier is left untouched.

name: fill_segment_jump_stubs
description: Writes the absolute-jump stub for each entry of a segment's jump table, using the table chosen by the segment number. The caller has already decided that the segment needs patching.

name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the first value passed on the stack without any other work. It is a pass-through stub and has no side effects.

name: open_dos_library_or_alert
description: Opens the DOS library, and if the open fails it raises an Amiga alert through the exec library. On success it waits for a signal in a loop and then appends the received value to a linked list.

name: store_long_at_pointer
description: Writes the 32-bit value in the data register to the memory address held in the address register. It has no other effect.

name: dispatch_song_command
description: Entry point of the music driver for the second song file, with the same command numbers and handling as the first file's dispatcher. Unknown command numbers simply return.

name: dispatch_song_command_alias

name: init_and_clear_program_data
description: Program entry for the main hunk: it calls an initialisation routine, zeroes a block of longwords in the data area, and stores the base pointers. It then checks a library result and either raises an alert on failure or hands off to the next routine.

name: init_and_clear_program_data
description: Program entry for the main hunk: it calls an initialisation routine, zeroes a block of longwords in the data area, and stores the base pointers. It then checks a library result and either raises an alert on failure or hands off to the next routine.

name: run_main_program_loop
description: Main program routine that allocates a memory block, sets up the graphics and intuition state, and then loops forever polling input. It touches the DMA control register and a custom chip register during setup.

name: poll_input_event_code
description: Waits through a short delay count and polls three input service functions until one reports activity. It then selects an event code from a table or from the device and stores it, returning the sentinel value when nothing was found.

name: read_pending_input_code
description: Polls the input service and returns an event code, taken from the table when a state is set or from a single poll otherwise. It clears the pending-input flags when the code is not the none value.

name: fetch_input_event_code
description: Returns the current input event code by checking the table state and polling the input service when needed, storing the result in the caller's frame. It clears the pending-input flags when a code is found.

name: poll_input_event_once
description: Polls the input service once and, when it reports a result, reads the event code and returns it. It clears the pending-input flags whenever a code other than the none value is returned.

name: allocate_playfield_bitmaps
description: Allocates three five-plane bitmaps, two 200 lines high and one 22 lines high, and links the first two as the front and back buffers. It then finishes the display setup with a final graphics call.

name: swap_display_buffers
description: Swaps the front and back buffer pointers and passes the new front buffer to a graphics library call that shows it.

name: set_back_buffer_coordinates
description: Passes the low and high 16-bit halves of its argument to two graphics calls for the back buffer, one call per half. It sets the buffer's two coordinate values.

name: set_front_buffer_coordinates
description: Passes the low and high 16-bit halves of its argument to two graphics calls for the front buffer, one call per half. It sets the buffer's two coordinate values.

name: return_routine_address
description: Returns the address of this routine itself, so a caller can obtain a function pointer to it. It has no other effect.

name: install_vblank_interrupt_server
description: Allocates a 22-byte interrupt structure, marks it as an interrupt node with the name Ticks, and points its data and code at the game's handlers. It then adds the node to the vertical blank interrupt chain.

name: load_colour_map_palette
description: Scans forward for the CMAP colour map tag, then converts 32 three-byte colour entries into 12-bit colour words. It passes the resulting palette to the graphics library.

name: dim_palette_to_half_intensity
description: Halves each red, green and blue component of the 32 palette entries and passes the resulting table to the palette loader. It produces a darker copy of the palette.

name: load_stored_palette
description: Passes the stored 32-entry palette to the palette loading routine and returns. It is a one-call wrapper.

name: load_alternate_palette
description: Passes a second palette block, stored just after the first, to the palette loading routine and returns. It is a one-call wrapper.

name: blend_palette_sixteen_steps
description: Fades the 32-entry palette over sixteen steps, moving each red, green and blue component toward or away from the stored palette depending on its parameter. It loads each intermediate palette as it goes.

name: init_palette_fade_components
description: Splits each palette entry into separate red, green and blue component arrays and clears the working copies. It then runs the stepping loop that adds or subtracts the component deltas and loads each intermediate palette.

name: step_palette_fade_frames
description: Advances the component arrays by one fade step for each palette entry, packs them back into colour words, and loads the palette. It repeats for sixteen steps and returns when the last one is done.

name: test_x_in_window_range
description: Returns one when the low word of its argument lies between two fixed bounds and the high bit of the 32-bit value is clear, and zero otherwise. It is a range check on a screen coordinate.

name: refresh_list_entries_from_buffer
description: Walks two sentinel-terminated lists of screen entries and, for every entry that passes a test, copies a word from the buffer at an index computed from the entry's screen coordinate.

name: load_track_and_dispatch_state
description: Loads the track file, resets the race flags, and then dispatches on a stored state value to one of three sub-steps. It returns the result code from the chosen step, or the abort value when the abort flag is set.

name: prepare_race_start_screen
description: Clears the ten race entry records, then runs the race preparation sequence, which sets the start flags and shows the Prepare to RACE text. It returns the input code from its final poll.

name: prepare_practice_start_screen
description: Sets up practice mode by clearing the practice flag and drawing the Prepare to PRACTICE text at a fixed screen position. It waits for input and returns that result.

name: run_qualifying_rounds
description: Runs up to eight qualifying rounds, clearing the lap records for each round and showing the Prepare to RACE screen before each start. When the rounds finish it compares the lap times to work out the driver's position and returns it.

name: prepare_qualifying_screen
description: Shows the Prepare to qualify text at a fixed screen position and records the best time when the result is minus one. It then waits for input unless the session was aborted.

name: draw_qualifying_results_sheet
description: Sorts ten entries by time with a selection sort, then draws the qualifying results sheet, printing each row's position, name, number and time from a format string.

name: load_race_resources_and_sounds
description: Loads the race graphics and sound resources, such as the track and car shape files and the engine and crash sounds, then releases the temporary handles. It sets the abort flag and returns an error status when loading fails.

name: mark_race_entry_inactive
description: Sets the status word of one race entry record to minus one, marking that entry as inactive. The entry index comes from the argument.

name: show_towed_to_pit_message
description: Draws the Towed to pit message and starts a 600-tick countdown, then runs the follow-up step. It is the screen shown when the car is towed in.

name: run_race_standings_screen
description: Runs the race standings screen in a loop: it redraws the track image and the ten position rows, sorts the rows by time, and waits for player input. It returns the input code that ends the screen.

name: prompt_save_or_load_slot
description: Prompts for a slot number from zero to nine, reads the typed digit, and then reads or writes the matching state file, chosen by its argument. It shows a Not Found or Disk Full message when the file operation fails.

name: list_saved_game_files
description: Draws up to ten saved game entries from the file directory and shows the No files message when none are found. It returns the status of the last directory step.

name: set_timed_sequence_state
description: Clears two state words, then either sets a flag when the current state is one or resets the countdown and sequence step to their starting values.

name: reset_countdown_and_step
description: Resets the countdown to its starting value of 400, sets the sequence step to one, and stores the state value of five.

name: step_countdown_sequence
description: Subtracts the frame step from a countdown and, as it passes each threshold, calls the routine for the current sequence step. When the countdown runs out it clears the counter and returns zero.

name: apply_countdown_thresholds
description: Checks the countdown against each threshold and, for the threshold matching the current sequence step, runs its routine and advances the step. It does not change the countdown itself.

name: reset_race_timing_state
description: Clears the lap counters, timing sums and best-time fields, sets a stage counter to one, and marks the pending time as minus one. It prepares the timing state for a new run.

name: accumulate_lap_time
description: When timing is active and the state allows it, adds the argument to a running total, keeps the largest value seen, and counts the lap. It also decrements a remaining-count field.

name: finish_lap_timing
description: Closes the current lap by adding its share to the running average and recording it as the best lap when it beats the stored best. It then clears the per-lap counters and advances the lap number.

name: draw_race_results_table
description: Draws the race results table with its header and one row per driver, marking entries that did not finish. It then adds championship points to the top six finishers and waits for input.

name: draw_race_statistics_panel
description: Draws the race statistics panel with its labels for lap number, best lap, total time and speed, then fills in the values from the timing records. It shows a zero value until the speed passes its threshold.

name: copy_long_return_constant
description: Copies one stored 32-bit value into a second location and returns the constant thirty-two. It is a small transfer used during setup.

name: animate_ordered_car_images
description: Runs a looping animation of car images on the display, drawing each row of frames in turn with a short delay. The car order comes from the stored entry indexes, and the loop ends when the input flag is cleared.

name: run_endgame_car_animation
description: Runs the same looping car animation for the end-of-game screen, loading the endgame graphics before it starts. It returns the status of the final step.

name: build_track_profile_tables
description: Converts 21 source samples into a scaled table, then searches a series of columns for matching entries and fills the flag and result tables from the matches. These tables are the lookups that the track display reads.

name: find_index_of_value
description: Searches an array of words backwards from a starting index for the given value and returns its index, or minus one when the value is not found.

name: show_track_loading_screen
description: Shows the loading screen for the track, drawing the loading caption and the track name at fixed positions. It uses a second caption when the stored flag is set and loads the track file first.

name: load_car_selection_resources
description: Loads the car selection graphics and data files, including the car select and F1 select shape files, then runs the two setup calls for the screen. It sets up the selection screen before its input loop starts.

name: run_selection_input_loop
description: Runs the selection screen's input loop: it reads key codes, restores the saved selection state when the restore key arrives, and returns once a code other than the ignored ones is received. It copies the state back to storage before returning.

name: wait_and_release_selection_resources
description: Waits for the pending call to finish, then releases the six loaded resources and the timing block. It is the cleanup step at the end of a selection screen.

name: draw_rectangle_outline
description: Draws a rectangle outline by moving to the first corner and drawing its four edges through the drawing routine. It takes the corner coordinates as its arguments.

name: lookup_named_graphics_items
description: Looks up six named graphics items by their four-character tags and stores the handles in the game record for later drawing. Two of the lookups reuse the same handle for a second field.

name: run_main_menu_input_loop
description: Runs the main menu input loop, moving the highlight with the cursor codes and redrawing the chosen option's images until a select, exit or abort code returns. The listing is cut off part way through, so only the visible part is described.

name: draw_name_entry_screen
description: Draws the name entry screen with its prompts, such as Enter Your Name and Laps Per Race, and shows the current name when one is already stored.

name: store_long_and_lookup_items
description: Stores a 32-bit value through the address register and then looks up two named items by their four-character tags, saving their handles in the game record.

name: lookup_named_item_pair
description: Looks up two named items by the same four-character tags from a second resource handle and stores their handles in the game record.

name: run_menu_selection_loop
description: Runs a menu selection loop that moves the highlight through the entries with the cursor codes, redraws the old and new items, and returns the key code when a select, cancel or exit key arrives.

name: show_scores_screen
description: Shows the scores screen by drawing the scores table, waiting for input to clear, pausing briefly, and then starting the next step. It marks the screen as finished when it returns.

name: set_timeout_and_wait
description: Stores the timeout argument, runs the wait step, and clears the pending-input flag unless the wait reported an abort. It returns one when the wait was not aborted and zero otherwise.

name: lookup_menu_item_handles
description: Looks up menu graphics items by their tags, including one named base item and one chosen by the current selection, and stores each handle in the game record.

name: run_title_input_or_demo
description: Runs the title input loop: when input is active it reads key codes until the exit code arrives, and otherwise it plays a timed sequence that simulates a cursor-left press a random number of times. It returns the final code once the loop or the sequence ends.

name: report_missing_pseudocode
description: No pseudo-code was produced for this routine because the decompiler timed out, so its behaviour is not recovered here. The listing facts show 88 instructions, one unnamed routine call and one caller.

name: scroll_sprite_pairs_across_screen
description: Loads two sets of eight named sprite items and a pair of further items, then advances a position by a speed derived from the frame time. Each frame it draws the sprite pairs at offsets from that position until the position passes its end or the input flag clears.

name: set_selector_display_values
description: Sets a flag to one when the selection index is below two and to zero otherwise, then derives two display values from the index: a doubled value and a position of twenty minus five times the index.

name: edit_text_field_input
description: Edits a text field from keyboard codes: the cursor keys move the insertion point, the delete keys remove characters, and printable characters are inserted up to the field length. It redraws the field after each change and returns the key code that ended editing.

name: draw_small_marker_box
description: Draws a small square marker at the given position by setting a drawing mode, outlining a box about eight units across, and restoring the mode. It is the cursor drawing step used by the menus.

name: run_title_screen_loading
description: Loads the title screen resources, such as the Accolade and title shape files and the start-up sound list, then shows the title for a timed interval and waits for a key. It frees the loaded resources and returns the input code.

name: wipe_in_title_graphics
description: Clears the screen, draws three named graphics items, then advances a reveal across the width in small steps with a short wait each. It stops early if a key arrives and returns the input code.

name: scroll_text_block_until_key
description: Loads three named items and scrolls the text block up the screen in steps until input arrives or the block reaches its end. At the end it draws a logo item, waits for input, and returns the input code.

name: draw_credits_screen_lines
description: Draws the credits screen lines, such as the group heading and the Art, Design, Programming and Sound and Music labels, at fixed positions. It does not wait for input or return a value.
